title: Daily Coinsurance Rate Schedule for Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage
content:
The daily coinsurance for benefit days 21 through 100 of Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage is the CMS-published amount for the calendar year in which the day of service falls. The schedule is the same in all six tiers.

| Calendar year of the day of service | Daily coinsurance (USD per day) | Tiers |
|---|---|---|
| 2025 | 209.50 | All six tiers |
| 2026 | 217.00 | All six tiers |

**Rounding basis (all tiers):** coinsurance amounts are rounded half up to the cent, each charge row on its own.

### Points of reading

- The year that selects the rate is the year of the day of service — not the year a charge is posted and not the year of admission.
- Rounding is applied per charge row: each row is rounded half up to the cent by itself.

*Hypothetical illustration:* a day of service furnished in 2026 is rated at 217.00 whichever year the charge for it is posted in; a day furnished in 2025 is rated at 209.50.
